words.sense: Free a person or thing that is caught in a difficult, constricting, or dangerous predicament.
words.connotation: neutral; often implies effort and difficulty
misconceptions: Every removal from any source counts as extrication.

words.sense: Take out or obtain something from a source, place, or material.
misconceptions: A difficult rescue is merely an ordinary collection process.

semantic_axes.description: Release from confinement or complication versus ordinary removal.
Liberating the trapped subject versus obtaining an item.

edges.boundary_rule: Extricate centers on freeing something from a trap or difficult predicament; extract centers on taking something out of a source.
clues_a: gets out of an inescapable commitment
clues_b: takes an object from a container

misconceptions.M1: Every removal from any source counts as extrication.
misconceptions.M2: A difficult rescue is merely an ordinary collection process.
misconceptions.M3: Using force or a tool alone determines the choice.

chains.frame: Which word best describes how Aya helped the child?

beats.text: Aya loosened the ropes around a child whose leg had become caught in a climbing net.
beats.decisive_clue: released a child caught in a rope net
beats.reason: The child was physically trapped and needed freeing.

beats.text: She carefully separated the knots until the child could step away.
beats.decisive_clue: untied the ropes that prevented movement
beats.reason: The knots confirm that escape from entanglement, not obtaining an object, was the purpose.

chains.feedback_short: The knots confirm that escape from entanglement, not obtaining an object, was the purpose.
chains.feedback_deep: The child was physically trapped and needed freeing. The knots confirm that escape from entanglement, not obtaining an object, was the purpose. Extricate frees what is stuck; extract takes something out.
chains.contrast_rule: Extricate frees what is stuck; extract takes something out.

hints.axis: Release from confinement or complication versus ordinary removal.
hints.contrast: Extricate frees what is stuck; extract takes something out.

beats.text: Chloe found replacements for two of five overlapping volunteer shifts that were stopping her from studying.
beats.reason: She was caught in a binding practical difficulty.

beats.text: She arranged the remaining swaps and gained release from the full schedule without leaving the charity short-staffed.
beats.decisive_clue: negotiated release from the difficult commitments
beats.reason: Securing replacements explains how she freed herself from that predicament.
